name: agent-design-taste
title_zh: 先问产品给谁用再动手的界面设计师
tagline_zh: 受够了千篇一律的「现代 AI 风」？它逼你先定受众和风格，再从真实 token 搭界面。
tagline_en: Tired of generic 'modern AI SaaS' look? It forces audience analysis, deliberate style choice, real tokens, then.
desc_en: Use when generating, redesigning or reviewing any UI — landing page, dashboard, app screen, component, or design system. Teaches the agent to analyze product and audience first, choose one design style deliberately, build from real tokens, render it, and audit it — instead of producing generic "modern premium AI SaaS" output.
why_zh: 机制上把「设计」拆成五步强制流程：分析→选风格→建 token→渲染→审计。每一步都有检查点。
why_en: Five-step enforced pipeline: analyze, style, token, render, audit. Each step has checkpoints, making generic output structurally.
limit_zh: 只作用于 UI 生成/评审场景，不负责交互原型或动效。需要 agent 能访问渲染工具链。
limit_en: Only for UI generation/review. No prototyping or motion. Needs render toolchain access. Won't fake it for game UI or data-viz.
title_en: A UI designer that asks who it's for before drawing
